expectations.evidence: The response says outright: "The skill's escalation rule is its own construction, not reported practice." It also says no industry-standard X exists, that inventing "30 minutes" would be fabrication, and that it did not search outside the skill. It treats Saltworks Hack's own measurement as the only real figure.
